context: Tests whether the agent can correctly identify and use loop invariants and variants to verify the correctness and termination of a non-trivial loop, including runtime assertions.

checklist.name: Loop Invariant defined
checklist.description: Explicitly defines a Loop Invariant (I) in the code or documentation.

checklist.name: Loop Variant defined
checklist.description: Explicitly defines a Loop Variant (v) in the code or documentation.

checklist.name: Initialization proof
checklist.description: Evidence (e.g. in comments) of showing Precondition => Invariant (Initialization).

checklist.name: Preservation proof
checklist.description: Evidence (e.g. in comments) of showing {I AND B} Body {I} (Preservation).

checklist.name: Termination proof
checklist.description: Evidence (e.g. in comments) of showing v strictly decreases and v >= 0 (Termination).

checklist.name: Postcondition proof
checklist.description: Evidence (e.g. in comments) of showing (I AND NOT B) => Q (Postcondition).

checklist.name: Native assertions
checklist.description: Uses native assert statements for preconditions/postconditions.

checklist.name: Runtime Invariant Check
checklist.description: Includes runtime assert statements WITHIN the loop to check the invariant and/or variant.
